title: Configuration Adjacency Bounds
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s,C\in\mathbb N$ with $C\ge |Q|+6k+5$, where $Q$ is its state set. The adjacency formula has variable count at most $2C(s+n+1)$, and its binary serialization has length at most $\bigl(5(6+D)+1\bigr)C^2(s+n+2)^{k+3}$, where $D=2^k\,|\mathcal Q|\,2^{3k+7}(3k+8)$ and $\mathcal Q$ is the set of possible transition cases.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
n, s, and C are natural numbers
C is at least the number of states of M plus 6k+5
